rebuttal_or_critique: I acknowledge the concerns raised by Dr. Patra regarding the headline CPI of 7.44%. However, I must emphasize that the 11.51% food inflation is largely a supply-side phenomenon, likely transient, and responding with a rate hike would be counterproductive. Monetary policy is a blunt instrument that cannot address specific food supply shocks; instead, it risks damaging the 7.80% GVA growth momentum. Core inflation at 4.90% confirms that generalized demand-pull pressures remain contained. While I agree with the Governor and Dr. Bhide on maintaining the current rate to anchor expectations, I caution against further tightening, as real interest rates are already in positive territory and sufficient to manage the current macroeconomic environment without stifling the recovery.
